scope: Only HPM01 completed-index tail-failure correction over frozen R2; no consumer/reuse/HPO/model/resource/clock change.
publication_identity: Successful _exclusive returns actual created inode identity plus expected raw-byte ref. finish retains that exact publication privately; wrapper independently rehashes and compares it before recording pending metadata.
pending_handoff: Persisted and returned trial_bank_producer state is pending_wrapper_parent_qualification, qualifies_completed_handoff=False. Even successful wrapper return is not a persisted completed handoff claim; future qualification must bind actual successful wrapper/parent exit and owned cleanup.
late_failure: Hash/reference check, HPO receipt write, final original checkpoint or context-reset failure removes additive returned producer metadata, attempts revocation of exact owned completed index only, then bare-raises the original exception.
revocation: Refuse symlink/replacement/nonregular/size/hash/inode mismatch. Recheck actual open inode and raw bytes, final path identity, unlink, then confirm path absence. Preexisting/unrelated paths are never revoked. Already-absent owned path reports removed=False. No recursive cleanup.
revocation_failure: Original primary type/traceback retained. Cleanup failure type is appended to bank_cleanup_secondary_types; bank_index_revocation_confirmed=False. No successful-removal or positive handoff claim is returned. Persisted original HPO ledger/numerics remain untouched and any additive receipt is pending/nonqualifying.
cleanup_deadlines: No new clock, sample timestamp or guard. Bounded <=32MiB exact-index cleanup remains charged to original outer HPO/task/parent/cleanup windows; it does not call the already-failed original checkpoint as a prerequisite to removal.
unchanged: HPO ask/tell/anchors/objectives/seeds/partitions/fair scheduling/caps, worker prepared/native/effective fit identity and parent/source/cleanup qualification unchanged. HPO/worker/native mock tests/template raw exact R2.
default_OFF: Whole3 current-base AST inverse exact23/5/13 with final source normalized SHA guard before mutation; existing legacy golden-helper composition still pending integration.
